correctness.rationale: The complete second-positive-fiber classification on the two-subset Johnson graph restricts every third query on an adjacent fiber to a branch containing at most two center pairs, and every disjoint second-positive fiber has only four centers. Hence a positive first fiber has no depth-four tree and the original class has no depth-five tree. Sharp lower trees at n=5 and n=7 are validated center-by-center, with embedding and small-cardinality arguments covering every n. Direct exact recurrences were run for n=2 through 9.

value.rationale: An all-order exact online dimension formula for triangular graphs, constant despite growing graph size, yields a sharp uniform online bound for every induced subgraph, identifies an abrupt threshold from depth one to three and the first depth-four instance, and complements the structurally distinct published static VC theory. The object is a standard line-graph/Johnson family, not an arbitrary finite slice.
